title: Do Agents Need a New Kind of Paper? SPRA: Structured Paper Representation for Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.21424v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scientific agents must connect research problems, methods, and findings dispersed through narrative articles. We introduce SPRA (Structured Paper Representation for Agents), a paper-level representation of persistent research objects and typed relations. Its empirical-AI profile organizes Problems, Contributions, Components, ExperimentSetups, Measures, and Findings for querying, traversal, and reuse. Selected paper-level citation relations record dependencies, component use, and comparisons with prior work; source locations support verification. We instantiate SPRA across more than one million AI papers, with 19.95 million research units and 24.07 million internal relations. Evaluations access SPRA through Schema-RAG with task evidence fixed before inference. Across seven subfields, SPRA improves source-conditioned scientific QA by 0.381/5 over passage retrieval while remaining close to Full Compact (0.078/5 lower on average). In directe

translated_title: 智能体需要一种新型论文吗？SPRA：面向智能体的结构化论文表示
translated_abstract: 科学智能体必须将分散在叙述性文章中的研究问题、方法和发现联系起来。我们提出了SPRA（面向智能体的结构化论文表示），这是一种论文级别的表示形式，由持久的研究对象和类型化关系构成。其面向实证AI的档案组织了问题、贡献、组件、实验设置、测量指标和发现，以支持查询、遍历和复用。精选的论文级引用关系记录了依赖关系、组件使用情况以及与先前工作的比较；来源位置则支持验证。我们在超过一百万篇AI论文上构建了SPRA实例，包含1995万个研究单元和2407万个内部关系。评估通过Schema-RAG访问SPRA，并在推理前固定任务证据。在七个子领域中，与段落检索相比，SPRA将基于来源的科学问答提升了0.381/5，同时性能接近完全紧凑表示（平均仅低0.078/5）。
tldr: SPRA提出了一种面向AI智能体的结构化论文表示方法，将研究问题、贡献、组件、实验设置、测量指标和发现等研究对象以类型化关系组织起来，并在超过一百万篇AI论文上构建了大规模实例，显著提升了基于来源的科学问答性能。
en_tdlr: SPRA introduces a structured paper representation for AI agents that organizes persistent research objects (problems, contributions, components, experiment setups, measures, and findings) with typed relations, instantiated across over one million AI papers and improving source-conditioned scientific QA over passage retrieval.
